headline: The Bull Case For Kroger (KR) Could Change Following Its New AI Shopping Assistant Launch - Learn Why
summary: In July 2026, The Kroger Co. launched an AI Shopping Assistant across its websites and apps, helping customers plan meals, discover recipes, and quickly build carts tailored to budgets and dietary needs. This move highlights Kroger’s push to deepen digital engagement and streamline online grocery shopping by blending in-store food expertise with AI-powered convenience.
